source:
@@U03375@@
Do what he will, While before him we fly, Be it far, be it nigh, He must follow us still!

@@U03377@@
(At a standstill.)

@@U03378@@
Blasted fate! Stupid, idiotic man! Deluded, duped, seduced since Adam’s first day! And age teaches us nothing! Nothing! Ah! Men! Eternal fools! Rotten is what they are! Rotten! Women! Worthless to the core! Bodies tight-laced, faces painted, bogs of depravity, touch them and you touch decay! We know it, feel it, see it at a glance, but let them start piping, we join their dance!

@@U03380@@
(Pausing.)

@@U03381@@
Halt! He's hesitating, reflecting! He’s stopped! Go toward him now, so he doesn’t escape.

@@U03383@@
(Striding forward.)

@@U03384@@
But once more unto the breach, as they say. Just don’t get all tangled up in doubt. Face it, if there were no witches, who the hell would want to be a Devil!

@@U03386@@
(Captivatingly.)

@@U03387@@
Let’s turn circles round this hero. He’s bound to find love in his heart for one of us.
translation:
@@U03375@@
做他想做的事，当我们在他面前飞翔时，无论远近，他都必须跟随我们！

@@U03377@@
（静止不动。）

@@U03378@@
被诅咒的命运！愚蠢、白痴的男人！从亚当出生的第一天起，就被迷惑、欺骗、诱惑！年龄并不能教会我们什么！没有什么！啊!男人们！永远的傻瓜！腐烂就是他们！烂！女性！骨子里一文不值！紧绷的身体，涂满颜料的脸，堕落的沼泽，触碰它们，你就触碰了腐烂！我们知道它，感觉到它，一眼就看到它，但让他们开始吹笛，我们加入他们的舞蹈！

@@U03380@@
（停顿。）

@@U03381@@
住手！他在犹豫，在反思！他停了下来！现在就朝他走去，免得他逃跑。

@@U03383@@
（大步向前。）

@@U03384@@
但正如他们所说，这又是一次突破。只是不要陷入怀疑之中。面对现实吧，如果没有女巫，谁会想成为恶魔呢！

@@U03386@@
（令人着迷。）

@@U03387@@
让我们围绕这个英雄转一圈。他一定会在心中找到对我们其中一个人的爱。
